- **PluginErrorBoundary.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/PluginErrorBoundary.tsx) — *Plugin error boundary*: Turn a render-time failure into a readable panel so Decky keeps the plugin alive.
- **TabBodyFocusRoot.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/TabBodyFocusRoot.tsx) — *Tab body focus root*: One `Focusable` around a tab's content that the collapsing tab bar can hand the ring to (Down from the bar) and that hands it back (Up from the tab's first control).
- **TabIndicatorBar.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/TabIndicatorBar.tsx) — *Collapsing tab bar*: The thin bar that replaces Steam's tab strip — one dash per mounted tab with the active one lit, the active tab's name beside the dashes, LB / RB marks at the two ends — and the full strip of icons and names that floats over the panel while the bar holds the ring.
- **jsdom.d.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/jsdom.d.ts) — *Minimal jsdom module declaration*: `jsdom` ships no bundled types, and this repo has no `@types/jsdom`; this covers only the `JSDOM` constructor shape the realm-crossing focus tests actually use.
- **modalReturnFocusRegistry.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/modalReturnFocusRegistry.ts) — *Modal return-focus registry*: Send D-pad focus back to the control that opened a fullscreen picker, once it closes.
- **pluginStorage.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/pluginStorage.ts) — *Plugin shell local storage*: Read and write the browser-storage values the plugin shell keeps between sessions.
- **tabBarNav.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/tabBarNav.ts) — *Tab bar D-pad and bumper handlers*: The handlers the collapsing tab bar's `Focusable` carries: Left/Right and LB/RB switch tabs (wrapping at the ends), Down hands the ring to the current tab's body, Up lets Steam go to Decky's Back button.
- **tabTitles.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/tabTitles.tsx) — *Decky tab titles*: Build the icon-only title element Decky renders for each bonsAI tab.
- **useCharacterPickerModal.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/useCharacterPickerModal.tsx) — *Character picker modal*: Own the AI-character picker modal and the save_settings write it commits.
- **useDesktopNoteSaveModal.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/useDesktopNoteSaveModal.tsx) — *Desktop note save modal*: Own the Save-to-Desktop confirm modal and its append_desktop_debug_note call.
- **useHiddenTabHeaderTrap.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/useHiddenTabHeaderTrap.ts) — *Hidden tab header trap*: When Steam's ring lands on one of its hidden tab buttons, hand it to the collapsing tab bar at once, so the hidden button never shows as a stop.
- **useOllamaConnectionState.ts** (src/features/plugin-shell/useOllamaConnectionState.ts) — *Ollama connection state*: Own the shell's host/connection slice — entered IP, effective host, reachability result, tab reset key.
- **useOllamaModelsHubModal.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/useOllamaModelsHubModal.tsx) — *Ollama models hub modal*: Own the models hub modal plus the two model-policy writes it can commit.
- **usePluginHelpModal.tsx** (src/features/plugin-shell/usePluginHelpModal.tsx) — *Plugin help modal*: Own the plugin-help chip's dismissed state and the modal that opening it shows.
